remarks: Studio in the Heart of SoNo! Location, location, location! This sun-filled studio puts you steps from everything South Norwalk has to offer-vibrant shops, award-winning restaurants, and lively nightlife-all just 0.3 miles from the Metro North Train Station for a quick commute to NYC. Inside, you'll find a bright, stylish space with an updated bathroom featuring modern shiplap detail, adding a fresh and inviting touch. Investor-friendly with no rental restrictions, this unit is a fantastic opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors alike. Move-in ready and available for a quick close, this is one of the most affordable options in the area-own for less than renting!
